name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog:
Cleans up leftover "API key" terminology from before the federation-token rewrite, which was genuinely confusing: a couple of error messages still said "API key is required" when a friend's token wasn't on file yet, reading like this plugin still expected a manually-entered admin API key even though nothing in the UI has asked for one to be typed in since the rewrite - a token is only ever minted automatically during the friend-request handshake. Those messages now say so explicitly, and a stray "keeps the remote API key server-side" hint was corrected to say federation token.

Also removed the "Remote server requires api_key for images" checkbox from a friend's connection settings - it stopped doing anything as of 0.0.70 (images now always go through the token-gated image gateway, the same as video/audio), so leaving it in the UI as if it were still a real toggle was actively misleading.

210 tests (unchanged - text/UI only, no behavior change).
